$description: Wave 3 (W3 Forms-Core, D-015) component tokens for HelperText. `default` tone reuses `color.text.subtle` (Text component's existing 'subtle' role) at 6.07:1 (light) / 7.55:1 (dark) against `color.surface.raised`. `error` tone reuses `color.action.danger.default` — the same already-AA-fixed (D-014) token Button/Link danger intent use, NOT a new danger step — at 6.91:1 (light) / 5.78:1 (dark) against `surface.raised`, and 6.50:1 / 6.07:1 against `surface.canvas`. Both tones clear the 4.5:1 text minimum in both themes on either surface this helper text is likely to sit on.
